_note: Recorded, redacted collections of the real estate, 24 Oct 2026: one tenant (client-1), two production hosts (nginx over read-only SSH) and one Cloudflare account (six zones, 18 months of audit log), exported from the app Postgres by scripts/export-bundle.ts. Hosts are the pseudonyms of their ssh aliases, names host-XXXXXX.<tld>, addresses ip-XXXXXX, the tenant's own labels word-XXXXXX, all salted with REDACT_SALT; every value_hash of a setting is an HMAC under that salt, only a file row's is the plain sha256 of its bytes. Nothing here maps an input to an answer: the catalogue queries run over these rows.
